method: Audit the exact nineteen mapped code relationships against immutable normalized catalog rows and approved media/reuse ledgers. Add source-context relationship study without claiming an unambiguous current checkout code.

policy.scope: Only these nineteen mapped targets; no queued neighbor is promoted.
policy.neighborRule: Include every other normalized catalog row with the same exact case-insensitive label or at least one exact shared code. Preserve full arrays, flags, source pages, and current manifest status.
policy.singleCodeRule: Quiz the exact recorded code only with the original source label and page visible.
policy.multipleCodeRule: Require the complete unordered recorded-code set. Neither code order nor a single member establishes a primary or universally correct checkout code.
policy.completionRule: Track relationship-study completion separately from ready-lesson recall and learned progress. All targets remain mapped.
policy.mediaRule: Reuse only the pinned reviewed file. Catalog grade, package, and source-page claims are not inferred from pixels; preserve source/author/license when materializing media.
policy.verificationBoundary: Catalog and review-ledger integrity verified locally; this ledger does not certify current store checkout rules or fresh remote asset availability.
